question: What must be written in the pericarp of the newly drawn eight-petaled lotus?
premises: An eight-petaled lotus should be drawn
The pericarp is the writing location
inference: One should draw an eight-petaled lotus and write the imperishable syllable in its pericarp
uncertainties: The exact syllable meant by dhruvam is context-dependent
plain_english: One should draw an eight-petaled lotus and write the imperishable syllable in the pericarp.
